name: Bamboo-tube soup
summary: Go Vietnam says highland communities cook canh thụt by packing lá nhíp, rattan shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish into a bamboo tube with spring water and roasting it over charcoal.
origin: Go Vietnam names canh thụt on the same article as the cassava-leaf and gnetum-leaf soups of the Jrai, Ba Na, Xơ Đăng, and Ê Đê, including the former Kon Tum area.
howToEat: Pack lá nhíp, rattan shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish into a bamboo tube with spring water. Roast the tube over charcoal. A time and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Highland communities covered by that article, including the former Kon Tum area. A Kon Tum address was not printed. Check on arrival.
